dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #Arama is on an adventure with Nara {NICKNAME}. Ararakalari match with Arama, Arabalika wants.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Arama...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #Big Iron Chunk is no match for Nara {NICKNAME}, and Arama is no match for Vanagni.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #But during adventures with Nara {NICKNAME}, Arama will beat Big Iron Chunks someday.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: When Arama becomes stronger, Arabalika wants another match with Arama.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Then Arabalika can continue the Ararakalari training, without leaving Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Ararakalari...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Before many sunrises, Arabalika was so weak in Ararakalari, almost weak as Paimon. Back then, Aradasha could kick the Big Iron Chunks over.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Later, when Arabalika finally beats running mushroom, Aradasha is nowhere to be found.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: That's bad. With no Aranara to kick the Big Iron Chunks over, the Big Iron Chunks will stomp their feet and turn Vanarana into a huge mess.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Luckily, the Big Iron Chunks now can't beat Arabalika. It must be blessings from Aradasha.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: When will Arabalika have another match with Arama...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: With lots of memories, Ararakalari power builds up. Another match between Arabalika and Arama at that time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Ararakalari...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Before many sunrises, Arabalika was so weak in Ararakalari, almost weak as Paimon. Back then, Aradasha could kick the Big Iron Chunks over.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Later, when Arabalika finally beats running mushroom, Aradasha is nowhere to be found.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: That's bad. With no Aranara to kick the Big Iron Chunks over, the Big Iron Chunks will stomp their feet and turn Vanarana into a huge mess.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Luckily, the Big Iron Chunks now can't beat Arabalika. It must be blessings from Aradasha.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About match...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Nara are so powerful, because they like matches. But many Aranara are like Aranakula, they don't like matches.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} is strong, should like matches.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #Nara Varuna, and Nara {NICKNAME}, which one is stronger? A match between Golden Nara, Arabalika wants to see.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #Bye, Nara {NICKNAME}, hope Nara {NICKNAME} will meet Nara Varuna.
